rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 3AA label, but the image itself looks more like an early/full blastocyst with a somewhat loosely defined ICM and TE that is not clearly uniformly cohesive; it also overstates visible thinning/expansion.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live birth, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions generally supported by the case data; minor overstatement of morphology-to-euploidy linkage and implantation estimate keeps it from perfect.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice, especially single embryo transfer in a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst; slight overemphasis on morphology predicting euploidy and optional PGT-A discussion is somewhat simplified.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, pregnancy testing, and future planning, though recommendations remain somewhat general rather than highly individualized to protocol details.
